correctness.rationale: The all-to-all Hamiltonian is rank one. Direct projection gives p(tau)=beta(1-cos(omega tau))/2 and the failed branch is a scalar multiple of the same uniform survivor state. Hence T=E[tau]/E[p(tau)]. The pointwise extremum of (1-cos x)/x is unique at tan(x/2)=x, and x>=pi is dominated by 2/pi. This proves the global waiting-law bound and its equality cases. The Poisson comparison follows from the exponential cosine transform.
